title: Lifting banal representations of classical groups
summary: Let $\mathrm{G}$ be a symplectic, a split orthogonal, or an unramified unitary group over a local non-archimedean field $\mathrm{F}$. A prime $\ell$ is called banal with respect to $\mathrm{G}$ if it does not divide the cardinality of the $k$-points of $\mathrm{G}$, where $k$ is the residue field of $\mathrm{F}$. In this paper we show that for every banal prime $\ell$, any smooth irreducible $\overline{\mathbb{F}}_\ell$-representation of $\mathrm{G}(\mathrm{F})$ admits a lift to $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}_\ell$.
